summary: BBVA filed a Form 6-K disclosing weekly share repurchases under the first tranche of a buyback program approved by its board on July 29, 2026. Between August 17 and 21, 2026, HSBC Continental Europe purchased 5,798,862 BBVA shares across XMAD, CEUX, AQEU, and TQEX venues at weighted average prices from €24.60 to €25.06, totaling €390.9 million, or 39.09% of the tranche's maximum cash amount. The filing is a routine buyback progress report under EU market abuse rules, reflecting ongoing capital return to shareholders. Watch for continued execution updates toward the program's full allocation.
